{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'severity' to verify 'SEVERE' is present
severity_unique = df['severity'].unique()
print('Unique severity values:', severity_unique)

# Check if 'SEVERE' is in the list
has_severe = 'severe' in df['severity'].unique()
print('Has severe disease category:', has_severe)

# Check the dtype of 'biomarker_baseline'
print('\nDtype of biomarker_baseline:', df['biomarker_baseline'].dtype)

# Check for sentinel values (-999)
print('\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
